readerCopy.body: An old source of power can be difficult to leave when it still provides access, influence, money, or protection that is hard to replace. When Pluto opposes the North Node, established leverage and forward movement face each other directly, making an old role, alliance, institution, or arrangement expensive to release even after it stops fitting the future. The benefits can be substantial and still create dependence. More leverage outside the arrangement turns staying into a choice rather than the price of keeping options open.
